name: fast-systemone-compaction
description: Verbatim compaction for Claude Code sessions, guided by System One.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

baseUrl.title: System One endpoint URL
baseUrl.description: Full URL of the System One endpoint, including the /v1/systemone path. Leave unset for TypeSafe at https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone. Set it to route to a self-hosted endpoint; the model option still chooses the model.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum System One probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum System One state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every System One request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum System One request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one System One request.

maxRequestChars.title: Maximum System One request characters
maxRequestChars.description: Exact character ceiling for one System One request, for an endpoint that caps the bytes it reads rather than estimated tokens. Leave unset for TypeSafe, which needs only the token budgets.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when System One decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name sent with every System One request; TypeSafe serves jev-latest.
